entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, hear my voice, and let Your ears listen to the voice of My prayers.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: If You will keep [in mind] iniquities, O Jehovah, who shall stand, O Lord?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But [there is] forgiveness with You, that You may be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: I wait [for] the LORD, my soul waits, and in His word I hope.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul [waits] for the LORD more than morning-watchers who are watching for the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: Let Israel hope in the LORD; for with the LORD [there is] mercy, and with Him [is] plentiful redemption.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And He shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
